summary: Iteration 144 — Soft-launch / Business Setup Mode. Comprehensive backend pytest suite (23/23 PASS) exercised every endpoint from the review request: /api/launch/status (mode OFF+ON, has_bypass, bypass_reason=admin/business), admin PATCH/GET /api/admin/launch-settings (auth gating, offer_months clamp 1..24, empty-body 400), POST /api/waitlist (invalid email 400, valid+dedupe returns stable position), GET /api/admin/waitlist, preview-tokens create/list/revoke, POST /api/launch/preview/redeem (invalid=400, valid sets rl_preview_token cookie, revoked=400), SERVER-SIDE GATE on /api/shell/home (423 anon with detail.code=business_setup_mode, 200 for admin session, 200 with X-Preview-Token header; open paths /api/auth/*, /api/admin/*, /api/waitlist, /api/launch/* NEVER return 423), GET /api/merchant/soft-launch/offer + POST /claim (idempotent — 2nd call returns already:true; after claim, freeuser gets bypass_reason=business when mode is ON). Regression: mode toggled OFF at the end and confirmed via curl (business_setup_mode:false) so live preview is not left gated. Web baseline confirmed via browser: anonymous `/` renders [data-testid=public-home-v2] with cookie banner. Deeper UI flow could not be automated end-to-end due to a Playwright selector ambiguity (see action items) — this is a test harness issue, not an app defect.
action_items: None from the backend — all 23 assertions passed and match the review spec (OPEN_PREFIXES honoured, 423 shape correct, cache TTL respected).

Test harness only: /login has three buttons whose accessible name contains 'Sign in' (Google, Apple, plain 'Sign in'). Next testing agent should target the credentials submit specifically — e.g. page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign in', exact=True) OR add a data-testid='login-submit-btn' to the plain-email Sign-in button in the login page for stable automation.

Optional hardening (main agent, low priority): consider narrowing OPEN_PREFIXES for /api/users — currently the ENTIRE /api/users tree is open. If any users-scoped consumer endpoint (e.g. hypothetical /api/users/{id}/feed) should be gated, add a stricter check. Same for /api/business — kept open as intended for signup, but /api/business/* covers many read endpoints too.
critical_code_review_comments: Fail-open on /api/launch/status is implemented correctly (try/except in useLaunchStatus.js AND server-side default settings) — a status hiccup will not lock everyone out.
Preview-token cookie is set httponly=False (deliberate — frontend also reads localStorage and mirrors X-Preview-Token header). Acceptable for a preview-access token, but flag if requirement changes.

resolve_bypass() bubbles a Mongo failure to False (returns not bypassed) — combined with fail-open on launch settings, a DB blip yields status=off in status but 423 in gate. Not blocking; documented via cache TTL 10s + status defaults.
bust_launch_cache() correctly called after PATCH admin settings, revoke token, and merchant claim so bypass changes reflect within one request cycle.
OPEN_PREFIXES generously covers /api/admin, /api/merchant, /api/business, /api/v1 — matches the spec (never 423 for those). Verified by test_open_paths_never_423.

success_rate.frontend: Partial — baseline mode-OFF anon `/` verified (public-home-v2 rendered); deeper flows blocked by login-button selector ambiguity (test-only).

seed_data_creation: Created + revoked one TEST_frontend_pv preview token during the aborted UI run; a few TEST_wl_* waitlist entries were created by the pytest suite (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green — feature is functionally correct. For the FE UI regression pass, either (a) add a data-testid='login-submit-btn' to the email/password submit button on the login page, or (b) use `page.locator('button:has-text("Sign in"):not(:has-text("Google")):not(:has-text("Apple"))').first`. Then run: login as admin@bigfm.dubai → visit /admin/launch → assert testids launch-mode-toggle, launch-waitlist-toggle, launch-months-input, launch-months-save, token-create-btn, launch-waitlist-card; toggle mode ON; wait 11s (cache TTL); in a fresh anon context assert coming-soon-hero, waitlist-form, waitlist-email, waitlist-submit, waitlist-success, coming-soon-business-cta; visit /listen and /shop, both should redirect to /; visit /login, /admin, /preview, /for-business — should NOT redirect; hit /preview?token=BAD → preview-entry-invalid; create a valid token in admin and /preview?token=VALID → public-home-v2 shown (bypass); login as freeuser@bigfm.dubai and visit /merchant/soft-launch → assert merchant-soft-launch, merchant-offer-card, merchant-claim-btn OR merchant-offer-claimed. IMPORTANT: turn mode OFF via /admin/launch at the end (or PATCH business_setup_mode_enabled:false) — currently confirmed OFF at end of iter144.
